name: drink-with-me
description: A passive-aggressive water reminder that costs zero tokens.

dailyGoalMl.title: Daily goal (ml)
dailyGoalMl.description: Water from drinks per day. EFSA: ~1600 ml (women) / ~2000 ml (men) from drinks; more in heat or with exercise.

sipMl.title: Glass size (ml)
sipMl.description: How much one 'I drank' press logs. 200-250 ml keeps intake spread out.

dayStartHour.title: First reminder (hour, 0-23)
dayStartHour.description: Reminders start at this local hour.

dayEndHour.title: Last reminder (hour, 1-24)
dayEndHour.description: Reminders stop at this local hour; 1-2 h before bed spares you the 3 a.m. walk.

nativeNotifications.title: Native notifications
nativeNotifications.description: Also nag through the OS notification, for when you have tabbed away to avoid me.
